title: Brainrot Kart
description:

Brainrot Kart is a multiplayer kart racing game where players compete in fast-paced, chaotic races. Choose from a variety of outrageous maps like "Gooning Gateway" and use unique items such as a Hawk Tuah ball to attack and sabotage other players. Show off your wild karts to your bros, including Quandale Dingle and Skibidi Toilet, each offering different kart stats.

BRAINROT KART FEATURES

Rizzy Brainrot Kart Action: Tear through chaotic maps and unleash wild items like the Hawk Tuah Ball

Goated Karts: Choose from cracked options like Quandale Dingle and Skibidi Toilet

Doesn't cost $80 like other kart games

Play Now

title: Can You Escape: The Collection
description:
Can You Escape: The Collection brings together 23 classic escape room games!

Each game features puzzles, hidden objects, and riddles set in a variety of locations like gaming rooms, garages, offices, basements, and more.

Across the collection, you’ll find over 300 rooms to unlock. All escape games are available from the start, so you can jump into any adventure you choose. The gameplay is simple, puzzle-focused, and designed for quick, satisfying challenges.

A perfect collection for fans of retro escape games or newcomers curious to experience these early classics.

title: Dead by Daylight: Stranger Things Complete Edition
description:
Dead by Daylight: Stranger Things Complete Edition

The Upside Down has crept into The Fog. Only by banding together does hope stand the slightest chance.
Dead by Daylight: Stranger Things Edition features the base game, the Stranger Things Chapter, and Stranger Things: Chapter 2. Playable characters include The Demogorgon, Vecna – The First, Steve Harrington, Nancy Wheeler, Dustin Henderson, and Eleven.
The Edition also features several Chapter exclusives: the Scuffed Rolled Sleeves Cosmetic (Steve Harrington), the Mind Flayer Badge, and the Bloody Rainbow Room Banner.

title: Dead by Daylight: Tokyo Ghoul Edition

title: Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered
description:
Return to the dark world of Nosgoth as you take control of both the vampire Kain and his betrayed lieutenant, Raziel, two powerful entities bound by the conflict between free will and fate.

Armed with legendary blades and supernatural abilities, battle through towering gothic spaces filled with enemies, puzzles, and long-buried secrets – where no victory comes without a cost.

Experience a timeless dark fantasy reborn for a new generation.

Legacy of Kain: Defiance Remastered has been updated with new HD graphics, refined controls, and a modernized game camera with the ability to toggle between the HD and original presentation any time. This new edition also boasts a photo mode, alternate character skins, a comprehensive lore reader, and unreleased content and 'lost levels' from the original game.

Dual Protagonist
Play as both Kain and Raziel, each with distinct abilities, combat styles, and perspectives that shape how the story unfolds.

Dark Fantasy and Rewarding Puzzles
Explore ruined cities, ancient temples, and towering strongholds filled with environmental puzzles, challenging enemies, and horrible secrets.

Faithfully Remastered for Modern Play
Updated HD visuals, refined controls, and a modernized camera, with the option to switch between modern and classic presentation at any time.

Character Skins
Earn alternate skins for both Kain and Raziel inspired by the Legacy of Kain canon.

This remaster includes fully localized UI and subtitles for all supported languages but some bonus and archival materials including the Encyclopedia, Lost Levels introductions, Arcane Tomes, and archival Comics are in English only.

title: Political Run: World Leaders
description:
Political Run: World Leaders

Political Run World Leaders is a 3D endless runner where recognizable world leaders sprint through chaotic city streets, slam into cars ahead of them and unleash explosive turbo boosts with powerful screams.

Choose a leader inspired by well-known political figures and dash forward in smooth third-person view. Avoid obstacles, jump over barriers, make quick lane changes and decide which vehicles you’re brave enough to hit. Cars with a health bar can be destroyed for bonus score, but every impact reduces your own health. Large trucks and heavy buses are instant game-enders, turning your heroic run into a spectacular crash.

Collect health packs to stay alive, grab NOS to recharge your scream-boost and activate consumable abilities purchased in the shop. Clear the traffic ahead, enter ghost mode for 10 seconds, slow down time for precise movement or double your score gain for a short burst. The farther you run, the more coins you earn – and the crazier your upgrades become.

You begin with a familiar businessman-style president, but a full roster of nine unlockable leaders awaits you – including shirtless strongmen, classic top-hat presidents and round-faced chairmen reminiscent of Trump, Putin, Obama, Kim and other iconic figures. Each leader features unique animations and upgradable stats for speed, boost power and health, letting you craft your ideal political runner.

Race through three dynamic city environments – sunny City Day, City Night and slippery City Rain – all backed by high-energy music to keep you pushing forward.

Features

World leader characters: Run with characters inspired by Trump, Putin, Obama, Kim and others, each featuring expressive animations and distinct personality.

3D endless runner gameplay: Third-person camera, responsive lane-switching, fast dodging, sliding and jumping through dense traffic.

Destructible and deadly vehicles: Break cars with health bars to earn score, while large unmarked trucks end your run instantly.

Turbo scream boost: Use NOS to unleash a shout-powered acceleration that sends cars flying in exaggerated cartoon-style explosions.

Useful power-ups: Collect health and NOS on the road, and activate shop items such as full NOS refill, full heal, traffic wipe, ghost mode, 2x score and slow-motion.

Progression system: Earn coins from distance and destroyed cars, unlock new leaders and upgrade stats such as speed, boost and health.

Multiple game modes: Enjoy Normal Run, survival-focused Health Mode and a high-pressure Time Trial challenge.

Perfect for players who enjoy endless runners, ragdoll physics, comedy games, arcade action, parody or political satire.

title: Smart Farm
description:
Smart Farm

Smart Farm is a farming and management game where you buy an abandoned farm at auction and bring it back to life with hard work, smart planning, and classic craftsmanship. Restore fields and buildings, care for animals, process your harvest into valuable products, and supply town and countryside – step by step, a ruined plot becomes a working farm.

The farm used to be the heart of the region – until it was abandoned. Broken barns, overgrown fields, rusted machines. Nobody wanted this piece of land… except you.
In Smart Farm, you take over a rundown, auctioned farm and rebuild it with patience, effort, and clear planning. No magic, no shortcuts – just honest work, solid systems, and your decisions.

You start with a few tools and a small amount of money. Bit by bit, you restore fields, repair buildings, buy seeds, and bring the first animals back to your farm. What you produce can be sold directly in town – or processed into higher–value products with better profit margins. Milk becomes cheese, grain becomes bread, fruit turns into jam. Step by step, you shape a farm that not only looks alive but runs on a sound economy.

Your choices matter: Do you invest first in new machines, more animals, or a small workshop? Do you focus on simple raw goods with quick turnover, or on longer production chains with better prices? Smart Farm rewards long–term thinking and a straight, consistent approach – just like real farms always have.

Key Features

Take over an abandoned farm
Start with a neglected, auctioned property: broken buildings, messy fields, limited resources – and full freedom to design your own farm.

Traditional farming gameplay
Work your fields with grain, fruits, and vegetables, take care of livestock, and manage your supply chains from soil to storage.

From raw goods to final products
Sell your harvest directly – or refine it. Turn milk into dairy products, grain into baked goods, fruit into preserved goods. More effort, more profit.

Supply the town and region
Deliver your products to the nearby town and various buyers. Different customers pay different prices and have specific demands.

Step–by–step rebuilding, not instant upgrades
Repair, extend, and modernize your buildings in clear stages. Nothing appears out of nowhere – everything comes from work, time, and investment.

Clear, transparent management systems
Track your income, expenses, storage, and production chains. Smart Farm focuses on understandable numbers instead of flashy gimmicks.

Calm but consequence–driven gameplay
There is no frantic timer chasing you, but your decisions have weight: careless spending keeps you small; careful planning builds a stable farm over time.

If you enjoy games where you build something from the ground up, where every decision shapes your future, and where a ruined piece of land slowly turns into a working, profitable farm, Smart Farm is made for you.

title: The Seven Enchantments
description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

The Seven Enchantments is a first-person psychological horror game set in the village of Pradonin, a forgotten place deep in 1800s Eastern Europe where religion, folklore, and sin intertwine. You are Józef, a fraudulent exorcist sent to help, only to realize something real and terrifying awaits. What begins as a simple con spirals into a psychological descent as you uncover the dark truth behind seven cursed villagers, each consumed by one of the seven deadly sins.

A Dark, Twisting Story

Some revel in sin. Others suffer from it. But all who give in are changed, twisted, and cursed. As Józef, uncover the intertwined stories of the villagers of Pradonin—their secrets, their sins, and their fates.
Why did this village fall? Who is truly behind the evil lurking here?
As you search the shadows… some may begin to look back.

Seven Characters, Seven Fates

Each villager you investigate represents a deadly sin. Explore their homes, trace their memories, and uncover clues. The truth might not be what you imagined, but Józef must face it all.

Secrets Hidden in Every Corner

In this world, stories are buried under rocks, behind doors, or in the quiet hum of the forest. But are you ready to discover how this story ends?

Gameplay & Features

Explore a cursed village: Every house, shrine, and shadow holds a secret tied to one of the seven deadly sins. Navigate dense forests, decaying huts, and sacred ritual sites.

Day/Night cycle gameplay:

By day, gather resources like candles, ritual tools, and scent-based stealth items.

By night, survive the hunt. The Leshy, a deadly creature from Slavic folklore, stalks you. Sound and light are your enemies—or your only hope.

Crafting & preparation:

Use the resources you collect to craft ritual candles, tools, and scent-based stealth items, shaping how you explore by day and how you survive the Leshy’s hunt at night.

The Wendigo – Your Second Hunter

There is something worse than the Leshy.

The Wendigo cannot be outrun. No resource protects you. No crafted item helps.
Your only weapon is eye contact: look directly at him to hold him back, hesitate, or look away at the wrong moment, and you pay for it.

Investigative horror: Find journals, ritual objects, and subtle environmental clues that piece together each villager’s story and reveal the curse at the heart of Pradonin.

Puzzle-based storytelling: Ritual circles, grotesque remnants, and ancient relics are keys to solving the mystery. Your curiosity may be your salvation—or your undoing.

Environmental storytelling & puzzles: Ritual sites, cursed relics, and grotesque scenes slowly reveal the truth—if you’re willing to look closely.

Multiple Endings

Your choices, your discoveries, your faith or fraud—everything is counted.
Different paths lead to multiple endings that reflect what kind of man Józef truly is… and what kind of curse you leave behind.

title: ARC Raiders
description:
ABOUT THIS GAME

SCAVENGE, SURVIVE, THRIVE

In ARC Raiders, gameplay flows between the surface ruled by lethal machines, and the vibrant underground society of Speranza. Craft, repair, and upgrade your gear in the safety of your own workshop, before venturing topside to scavenge the remnants of a devastated but beautiful world. Play solo or in parties up to three, navigating the constant threat of ARC's machines and the unpredictable choices of fellow survivors. In the end, only you decide what kind of Raider you are - and how far you’ll go to prevail.

EXPLORE AN IMMERSIVE WORLD

Explore four distinct maps at launch, with more to be revealed as the underground society evolves and expands its reach. Each destination carries the weight of a world twice-destroyed, and the scars of conflicts both old and new. Sift through the remnants for valuable loot, and piece together the past as it's slowly reclaimed by nature. Evolving map conditions ensure that no two runs are the same, with varying weather, enemies, and mechanics adding unpredictability and danger.

STAKE YOUR CLAIM

In a society built on boldness and bravado, it is up to you to stake your claim as a Raider. The loot you scavenge can be sold for coin or crafted into all-new gear, allowing you take on increasingly lethal dangers head-on. Through both victories and hardships, you'll gain valuable experience; unlocking varied skills that enable all-new ways of play. In addition, you'll complete quests for Traders with differing motives and agendas; uncovering both the friction and comradery of a community under constant threat of collapse.

BEWARE THE MACHINES

Lethal machines known as ARC rule the surface, ranging from unrelenting drone swarms to mechanical giants that obliterate everything in their path. Their origins remain a mystery, but their ever-present danger is felt with every step you take. Each machine comes with distinct strengths and tactics, forcing you to pinpoint their weak spots and constantly think on your feet. And remember: the noise of battle carries. Other Raiders may be listening; eager to claim what you leave behind.

FORGE YOUR OWN PATH

Raiders survive by kitbashing scavenged materials; using long-lost tech and looted ARC parts to craft weapons, gadgets, and gear. Upgrade your workshop stations and learn blueprints to craft even more advanced items, or improvise quick fixes in the field to get yourself out of a bind. As you make a name for yourself, you'll be able to measure your skill against other Raiders by taking on Trials; rising through the leaderboards to earn valuable rewards.

QUESTS

In Speranza, everyone has an agenda, and the Traders are no different. They’ll send you topside on missions in exchange for rewards, slowly revealing more about who they are and what they want for Speranza’s future. Complete quests to earn gear, crafting materials, and XP to level up your Raider and unlock new skill points.

SKILL TREE

The ARC Raiders skill tree branches into three paths: Survival, Mobility, and Conditioning. Spend your points to shape your playstyle. Loot faster and move quieter with Survival skills. Outmaneuver your opponents and threats with Mobility. And enhance your Strength and Stamina with Conditioning. Choose how you grow and what your Raider brings to the battle.

BUILD YOUR ARSENAL

Whether you’re preparing to take down specific ARC enemies or fend off rival Raiders, there's a choice of weaponry for every fight. Cater to your style with a range of firearms including SMGs, rifles and shotguns, as well as more advanced options such as railguns and energy weapons. Grenades, traps, ziplines and deployables offer the tactical depth needed to outsmart your enemies, while augments allow you to tailor your loadout to your preferred playstyle; unlocking dedicated inventory slots and additional gameplay perks.
